description: Fetch a single Job Description by id from the user's Jobs Module library. Returns the full parsed JD content (parsed_content, salary, classification codes). This is the canonical lookup used by analyze_job_fit, generate_cover_letter, and rewrite_cv_for_job. For Job Tracker pipeline entries (status/dates/notes), use get_tracked_job.

id.description: The Job Description ID (jd_id). Get from list_jobs, list_tracked_jobs (via jd_id field), or import_job_from_url.

name: get_job
